cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your apology should mention interrupting the chair, not just spilling the tea. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry about your trousers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The trousers hold no office.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry I interrupted you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Chair.' Let's repair the title while we're here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology should mention interrupting the chair, not just spilling the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry about your trousers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The trousers hold no office.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry I interrupted you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Chair.' Let's repair the title while we're here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You told the trainees their head trainer was an idiot. I want an apology.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry your drill failed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For undermining their head trainer. They still need to follow my instructions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll email them after tomorrow's drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read it to them before the drill. My whistle isn't going to outrank 'idiot' on its own.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I email you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I email you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign here to say you support the extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like it, but I'd rather not put my name down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your support has no address when objections arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I use initials?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if we print the key beside them.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. As junior coordinator, you're responsible for the blocked sink. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran the whole event yesterday. You said I'd earned a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. To senior coordinator. Still below me, but now you can supervise the plumber.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He can only come after everyone leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll lock up too. I can't give building security to a junior.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As junior coordinator, you're responsible for the blocked sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran the whole event yesterday. You said I'd earned a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To senior coordinator. Still below me, but now you can supervise the plumber.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He can only come after everyone leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll lock up too. I can't give building security to a junior.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're my deputy. You'll answer the inspector's complaints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Most of them concern decisions you made.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. You handle the details below decision-making level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The inspector wants whoever signs the replies at tomorrow's hearing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign as deputy, then. You can represent me without giving the impression we're equals.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I book the trip, who can still cancel it? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The committee approved it. Please book before we lose the coach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Whose objection would stop you paying the deposit?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer's. But she's away, and her deputy has the bank login.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can the deputy release it alone, or does she still need the treasurer's permission?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I book the trip, who can still cancel it?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer's. But she's away, and her deputy has the bank login.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can the deputy release it alone, or does she still need the treasurer's permission?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The pipe's still leaking. Which signature releases the repair money?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All three. I've spent all morning getting them.

beats.text: Could anyone still freeze it after your morning's work?

beats.text: Finance could. Though they unfroze the roof payment when the caretaker called.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the caretaker have: permission to overrule finance, or someone else's direct number?

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Sit with me for the allotment shed vote. It shouldn't look like just my project. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only support it if everyone gets a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Shared keys. Agreed. Will you join me now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The new plot holders need to hear that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring them over. We can present it together as the shared-access proposal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit with me for the allotment shed vote. It shouldn't look like just my project.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only support it if everyone gets a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shared keys. Agreed. Will you join me now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The new plot holders need to hear that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring them over. We can present it together as the shared-access proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you join my request to keep the pottery room open late? It looks like a personal favour with one name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I leave at five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name would show it's bigger than the evening class.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The morning class wants weekend access.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add that. Could you bring two of them? We'd be several classes asking for better access.
